interfaceBoundary: Topics I reconstruction still starts from SourceTopicsIChainReconstructionPrerequisite, which supplies the recognition and elementary reconstruction hypotheses cited from Topics I.

Finite core, rational cuspidalization, integral ind-system, critical coric carrier, cyclotomic comparison, restricted field, archimedean core, and covering system are selected from candidate_exists or compatible_exists fields by Classical.choice.

SourceNonarchimedeanSelectedPlaceCompatibility supplies the reconstructed/concrete ind-system comparison, the Frobenioid-side unit embedding, its exact image through SourceCoricIntegralUnitEmbedding, and injectivity.
The new files do not construct the recognition structures from this project's initial theta data or prove IUT II Definition 4.9's group/Frobenioid Kummer comparison.
localIntersection: The proved LeanFormal mono-analytic integral-unit Kummer injectivity can eventually discharge the unitEmbedding_injective field after a type bridge and an actual Frobenioid-side embedding with exact image are constructed. It does not supply those missing objects.
decision: Do not bulk-port either new file now. Retain the recognition/comparison design and reuse individual derived constructors only when the current C-layer has constructed their exact hypotheses.
impactOnCLayer: Useful specification and a future target for the newly proved local Kummer injectivity, but no immediate closure of initial-theta realization, Frobenioid evaluation, Definition 4.9 comparison, Hodge theaters, theta-links, or log-links.
impactOnTheorem311Corollary312: No direct discharge of the IUT-specific Ind1-Ind3 construction, IPL, SHE, APT, holomorphic hull, determinant/tensor normalization, or actual log-volume comparison.
